title: Changelog hero narrative strip and compact onboarding snapshot set
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable image pack for the March changelog and quickstart docs that tells the product story as a horizontal 'hero narrative strip' plus a set of annotated onboarding snapshots. Focus is on feature callouts, a before/after toggle for UI changes, and a mobile+desktop export set suitable for blog headers, changelog tiles, and in-product help.
acceptance_criteria: Hero strip: 5-frame horizontal sequence that illustrates the end-to-end flow for the new rollout policy UI; each frame annotated with a single callout and corresponding microcopy
Before/After toggle assets: side-by-side desktop and mobile screenshots with overlay callouts for 'before' and 'after' states, exported as PNG and layered PSD/Figma files
Compact onboarding snapshots: 6 cropped screenshots (desktop/tablet/mobile) optimized for quickstart docs and social sharing (1200x630 and 820x312 variants)
Accessible alt-text for every exported image and an asset index CSV with filenames, captions, and recommended placements
Localization: English source plus placeholders and exported masks for translation-ready overlays (i18n) for 4 locales: en, fr, de, ja
Signoff: PM and engineering review completed; assets pushed to marketing CDN and linked in the release blog draft
assets_needed: Figma: hero-narrative-strip (master) with componentized callout tokens
Layered source files: .fig, .psd for two hero variants (light/dark)
Export: PNG (web), JPG (blog header), SVG annotated badges, and optimized WebP variants
Annotated hotspot overlays as separate mask layers for translation teams
Design tokens for color/spacing matching Redwood Console theme
